title: Tips and information for your Auckland wedding | Moments In Light
description: Whilst we can't have all of the information there is we have picked select wedding vendor info for you to save you some leg work.

blocks.html:
Wedding resources, plan your wedding

We want this to be a place where we can find other information and tips for planning your wedding. Sure, you can’t beat Google when you want ALL of the information, but our plan is to provide a more curated list of select wedding vendors in the Auckland region. We scour the internet and talk to Auckland wedding vendors so that you don’t have to, just like a friend would. We are happy to go the extra mile to help our couples prepare for the big day.

We have information on a wide variety of subjects like wedding dresses, wedding suits, cakes, invites, writing wedding vows, choosing a celebrant, getting help with how to dance and much more. That being said, if there is something you think we have missed or if you are a vendor that wants to share your information, please get in touch we would LOVE to chat with you,

If you came here looking for inspirational wedding pictures try here and if you want to see our awesome wedding packages try here. Otherwise, dig in, each panel below links to a whole page on that topic and we are constantly adding more.
